images.screen: A — 정찰·계획: 감시 공백 표를 보며 공병의 함정 시각을 정한다 (Recon & plan on the watch-gap timeline)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A real-time tactics planning screen styled as a 1920s constructivist print, strictly three colors: signal red, near-black ink, and warm cream paper, with coarse halftone dots, slight red misregistration and paper grain. Top: a skewed black header slab with a huge heavy Korean title and a red diagonal bar, boxed objective chips and supply counters. Left two thirds: a stylized top-down map of a dusk ridge outpost made of angular zone slabs (ridge, treeline, dry gully, cart track, guard post, shed) with thick black drop shadows; zones currently watched by patrols are filled with red halftone, blind zones are cream with dashed red outlines; black triangle guard tokens, red diamond squad tokens, dashed noise-blocked links with small −40 tags. Right: three squad dossier cards with red silhouette portraits and big stencil stealth numbers. Bottom: a black timeline panel of per-zone rows with red hatched watched spans, cream gap spans, red order blocks and star trigger markers, a cream playhead. Korean UI: "능선 초소, 해질 무렵", "감시 공백", "공병".

images.screen: B — 실행: 두 함정이 소리 없이 두 순찰을 지운 순간과 거점 보수 선택 (Execution: silent ambush, then camp repair)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same constructivist red-black-cream tactics game at the moment the ambush resolves, 16:9.
